# FLX-3636: the SQL check could not read a consumer query or view

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

sqlglot or the check raised an error that no other code names while reading, qualifying or writing the text. The text is refused rather than run on a reading that did not finish. The message names the error's type. A text that reaches this code is worth reporting with the text that provoked it.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3636
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
